Self explanatory. Should we consider moving the field specs from ArkLib to CompPoly along with the ToMathLIb dependency these have in ArkLib? It seems like any place we would use these we would also be ok to import CompPoly anyway. Binary fields may be a special case since there is more theory attached to it?
cc @Quang Dao since I believe you introduced these.
Makes sense to me, since these are concrete (computable) implementations
Sounds good to me (even the binary field one)
Ack! Will do this once we add the comppoly dependency after the 4.26 bump then (as well as deleting the stuff that was already copied over to comppoly).

These pull requests are live! They port over all the field specs into CompPoly, along with minimal dependencies.
on the Arklib side: https://github.com/Verified-zkEVM/ArkLib/pull/309
on the CompPoly side: https://github.com/Verified-zkEVM/CompPoly/pull/84
Please leave any comments/feedback. The port should be pretty clean and straightforward, but note that it includes some of Arklib's ToMathlib/ directory
